title: From Fair Representation to Just Recognition in Generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical and philosophical evaluation drawing on political theory (specifically Nancy Fraser's concept of 'justice as recognition') to critique existing epistemic and accuracy-oriented metrics used to evaluate representational harms such as stereotyping, denigration, and erasure.

Conceptual analysis critiquing existing sociotechnical pipelines (e.g., Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), sociodemographic persona prompting, and pluralistic value datasets) for their limitations in accurately measuring or reflecting fluid, contested cultural symbols without essentializing them.
